doc.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11

title: Johnny Fischer, Casino Gardens and Frank Christian in New York
summary: Christian recalls Casino Gardens in Chicago with Fischer and Rose, and bringing his brother Frank to Chicago and New York.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Did you know Ricky Tom or Tom Ricky? Tom Ricky. Yeah. Tom Ricky. Now he traveled didn't he huh?
Uh Tom? Yeah. I don't know. I don't know if Tom traveled.
I'm trying to remember. Somebody told me. I think it was Nick LaRocca told me about him. Maybe. Oh there's so many of them. Now uh what about Johnny Fisher? When did he get in Chicago?

I don't even know. He must have came after we left. Johnny was up there with me. He was playing with me up there. Did he come after we had gone? In 16. He was up there in 16? Yeah. You all uh you all left already for New York. You all left for New York.
Well we left for New York in January or something like a 17.

You see? Because I was up there at uh where you all were playing before at uh Ackenbauer. At Greaves. Uh downstairs in the cellar. What was that called? Toucan Gardens was it? No uh uh Casino Gardens. Casino Gardens. That's right. I was playing. We had Johnny Fisher on clarinet uh Fred Rose on piano. I was playing trombone then and I think we had uh Merritt on clarinet. Yeah I got the picture home. Merritt on clarinet and uh.
Excuse me a second. Oh pause my. Go ahead.
Is that five after one? Yeah it's five after one. Okay I gotta pack and get up here to eat. It's tomorrow. We leave at six something in the morning.
But when did uh Hashiobake and Frank Christian and uh Johnny Stein get in New York? They had Frank low time?
I brought my brother up there. I brought Frank up there. Yeah.
And that was uh after Tony got there?

No yeah yeah Tony they had left there. And I brought I brought Frank up to see when I went up back up to Chicago. I sent for my brother Frank and got him up there in Chicago. And then from Chicago he went to New York and went with Jimmy Durante. That's all picture then. And then they had uh Bakke. Yeah. Jimmy Durante.
Johnny Stein. Uh Frank low tag on trombone. That's all five months. Yeah. Uh and Jimmy. Yeah. I got the pictures on. We got big pictures of it.
